params.name: context
params.description: Scope under which the request is made; determines fields present in the response. Anonymous callers may only use `view` and `embed`.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Maximum number of items to be returned in the result set.

params.name: search
params.description: Limit results to those matching a string.

params.name: type
params.description: Limit results to items of an object type.

params.name: subtype
params.description: Limit results to items of one or more object subtypes.

items.docs: Cross-content search over published posts and pages, returning lightweight {id, title, url, type, subtype, _links} records. A query for "gelsolin" returns 137 matches; a query for "ards" is the fastest route to the BTI-203 clinical-trial material. This is the only full-text entry point on the surface — there is no dedicated site-search API.
